initial_pilots: Three runs at 600 steps; no final test predictions generated.
extended_pilots: Two further runs at 6000 steps chosen after train/validation-only results. Same training data and algorithms.
validation_selection: memory/fly best 94.0705% at 2000 steps; pooled/fly best 70.2123% at 2000. All confirmation conditions receive 6000 steps, selection on validation only.
implementation_note: After pilot start, encode() validation was tightened to reject fractional nonbinary input before casting. All datasets are integer binary, so preprocessing for these runs is unchanged.
